blocks.label: Header
blocks.description: The top of the email: the business's name, over a photo from the library if you like.

blocks.label: Heading
blocks.description: A line set large, such as the email's headline.

blocks.label: Greeting
blocks.description: How the email addresses the reader, such as "Hi Beautiful".

blocks.label: Paragraphs
blocks.description: Body text, one or more paragraphs.

blocks.label: Offer
blocks.description: A tiered offer, such as a membership: its name, a summary, and tiers with prices and typed benefits. Always written for each campaign, never fixed.

blocks.label: Button
blocks.description: What the reader should do next, and the web page it opens.

wording.says: An email with an offer needs one.

blocks.label: Image
blocks.description: A photo from the client's image library.

wording.says: Its description, what a reader gets when images do not load, gets the text checks.

blocks.label: Sign-off
blocks.description: The closing: a valediction, who it is from, and a tagline if you like.

blocks.label: Fine print
blocks.description: Terms, disclaimers and other small print.

wording.says: Any text here counts as the disclaimer a medical term needs.

blocks.label: Spacer
blocks.description: Space between blocks. It holds nothing.
